name: @findbycolor/fbc-orm-schema
description: Find By Color Object Relational Mapping Schema
author: Find By Color

scripts.fix:integer: for i in ./api-models/*.js; do sed -i '' 's/DataTypes.INTEGER.UNSIGNED(10)/DataTypes.INTEGER(10).UNSIGNED/g' $i; done
scripts.fix:decimal: for i in ./api-models/*.js; do sed -i '' 's/DataTypes.DECIMAL.UNSIGNED(8, 2)/DataTypes.DECIMAL(8, 2).UNSIGNED/g' $i; done
scripts.fix:whitespace: for i in ./api-models/*.js; do sed -i '' '/^$/d' $i; done
scripts.fix: npm run -s fix:integer && npm run -s fix:decimal && npm run fix:whitespace && npm run -s fix:beautify && npm run -s test
